correctness.rationale: The stationary Poisson convolution gives conditional Gaussian variance as a sum of geometrically damped exponential holding times, hence an exact positive product for the MGF on |theta|<1. A Riemann sum gives the Li2 cumulant limit with steep derivative and exponential tightness; exponential tilting proves the full LDP, not just weak convergence. The stated Itô diffusion has stationary power-law density giving J by Laplace bounds. Strict I>J follows from the positive function z^2-2z+2(1-e^-z), whose derivative is positive, and series inversion yields the sixth-order gap. An independent SymPy series inversion and rate expansion matched coefficients. No path-space or finite-s error statement is inferred.
